cards.title: The switch moves inside the rack
cards.question: Why does scaling AI accelerators create a new switching silicon market?
cards.selfCheck: Scorpio fabric links GPUs; test switch attach per rack.
cards.prompt: FACT: Astera Nov 3 Q3 Scorpio X-Series 320-lane fabric switches entered volume production and became its largest product family. HYPOTHESIS: rack-scale fabrics increase connectivity silicon dollars per accelerator as systems grow. TEST port counts, switch attach, competing in-house silicon, power per bit and sustainable gross margin. 7d: no new verified product-specific milestone; 30d: Nov 3 earnings; 90d: earlier rack-scale roadmap. https://asteralabs.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/astera-labs-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results

cards.title: ALAB's new revenue engine
cards.question: Can Scorpio's scale outpace legacy retimer demand?
cards.selfCheck: Scorpio led Q3; test mix, customer concentration.
cards.prompt: FACT: Nov 3 Astera reported Q3 revenue $584.9M, +49% sequentially and +154% YoY, with Scorpio its largest product family. HYPOTHESIS: fabric switches increase addressable content per AI rack beyond retimers. Not undiscovered or necessarily cheap. TEST Scorpio revenue mix, customer diversity, margin sustainability, competing switch designs. https://asteralabs.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/astera-labs-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results

cards.title: Volume now; durability next
cards.question: What did the Nov 3 Scorpio production milestone actually establish?
cards.selfCheck: Volume is real; repeat orders are unproven.
cards.prompt: ORIGINAL Nov 3 2026 management disclosure: Scorpio X-Series 320-lane fabric switch reached high-volume production and largest product family. NEW PROOF: none independently verified since; avoid calling a prior announcement fresh. NEXT 2-6 months: follow sequential Scorpio shipments, inventory, design wins and repeat orders. FAILURE: hyperscaler insourcing or slowing orders. https://asteralabs.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/astera-labs-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results

cards.title: 154% growth sets a high bar
cards.question: What if extraordinary Q3 growth normalizes faster than expected?
cards.selfCheck: Growth is proven; valuation support needs repeatability.
cards.prompt: FACT Q3 revenue +154% YoY and +49% QoQ. HYPOTHESIS market could overestimate durability if initial Scorpio stocking is mistaken for steady-state demand; alternatively multiple platforms can sustain growth. No verified current consensus or forward multiple, so no mispricing claim. TEST sequential revenue, guidance, gross margin, inventories, customer concentration and verified valuation before action. https://asteralabs.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/astera-labs-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results

cards.title: WATCH ALAB; require repeat orders
cards.question: Which evidence upgrades a successful launch to a durable investment case?
cards.selfCheck: WATCH repeat switch orders and margins; reject one-off stocking.
cards.prompt: Educational WATCH, not a trade instruction. Before entry require a second sequential quarter of Scorpio-led growth, stable margin, expanding customer base and a separately verified forward valuation with reasonable growth assumptions. INVALIDATE if switching designs are displaced, inventory swells, growth slows abruptly or margin erodes. 2-6 month checkpoint: next two earnings disclosures. https://asteralabs.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/astera-labs-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results

cards.title: A ramp isn't recurring demand
cards.question: How do you distinguish channel fill from lasting deployment?
cards.selfCheck: Compare sell-in, repeat orders and installed capacity.
cards.prompt: Use Astera's Nov 3 Scorpio production milestone as a case study: design win -> first production -> initial stocking -> repeat deployment -> margin/cash conversion. Q3 volume establishes initial adoption, not an annuity. Look for independent customer deployment and second-quarter follow-through. Contrast with Nov 20 GF SiGe agreement, which remains earlier in the revenue bridge. https://asteralabs.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/astera-labs-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results
